text:
sophia: Kicking off the controlled rollout for feature flag `route_v2_split` at midnight change window (00:00 UTC). Plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 20m soak per step. Deploy pinned router service to v2.3.1 during the window. Release notes updated: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/2026-03-20-route-v2

deploy-bot: Starting deploy pipeline for service `router` -> version v2.3.1. CI checks passed. Scheduling canary at 00:05 UTC.

kai: Thanks — quick reminder: gating on p50 latency (<120ms) and error-rate (<0.5% 5m). If either breaches, we hold and evaluate rollback. Also ensure KV cache hit rate doesn't drop >5%.

tanya: Added health check: synthetic trace against /v1/generate with typical prompt. If latency regresses >20% we auto-hold.

pranav: Ops question — are we pinning any model variants for canary? I want to avoid mixing quantized and non-quantized variants mid-ramp.

sophia: Good call. Pinning model-router to model-family `small-lm@q4` for this rollout. No runtime downgrade allowed during ramp.

leah: Release notes: called out fallback policy (route_v2_fallback -> v1) and cost impact estimate (+6% tokens). Added customer-facing blurb for platform teams.

ops-sre: FYI I put an alert on the SLO dashboard for `router.p50` and `router.error_rate_5m` with a 2min notification delay. Pager oncall if we cross critical thresholds.

kai: Command I'll run on ramp steps (for audit):
```
/ff ramp route_v2_split --percent=10 --duration=20m --audit="midnight rollout" 
```

pranav: Put deploy-bot note to record the rollout ID so we can trace logs. Also create ephemeral debug VM in eu-west for quick repro if needed.

deploy-bot: Rollout ID ROLLOUT-20260320-017 created. Initiating canary cohort at 10%. See logs: https://logs.redwood/rollouts/ROLLOUT-20260320-017

deploy-bot: Canary checks: synthetic OK, p50=110ms, error_rate_5m=0.12%, kv_hit=94%. Proceeding to 25% in 22m.

kai: Good. Keep an eye on tail latency too (p95). If p95 > 300ms hold and ping infra.

tanya: Noted. Also toggled debug sampling to 0.5% to capture a few full traces.

pranav: Observability note — I patched the trace mapping to include rollout_id header so we can correlate traces with ROLLOUT-20260320-017.

ops-sre: Seeing a small blip in eu-west p95 at 00:42 UTC (+12%). Not yet above hold threshold but watching.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 50% scheduled for 01:00 UTC. Current metrics: p50=115ms, p95=280ms, error_rate_5m=0.18%, kv_hit=92%.

leah: Also flagging that finance wants a heads-up if cost delta crosses +10% — current estimate still under +6%.

kai: If we need to abort, rollback plan: set `route_v2_split` to previous cohort set (100% -> 0%) and pin router back to v2.2.8. Deploy-bot will mark rollback as emergency if done outside change window.

deploy-bot: 01:05 UTC: Ramp to 50% completed. No auto-holds triggered.

ops-sre: Incoming: p95 spike in ap-south at 01:22 UTC to ~410ms; error_rate climbs to 0.9% for ~3min. I'm recommending pause and investigation.

kai: Hold the ramp at 50% now. roll_back_checklist: 1) Confirm whether spike is traffic-pattern related 2) Check infra scaling events 3) If we can't mitigate in 15m -> rollback.

pranav: Investigating. Looks like a model cache miss storm from a non-typical prompt vector. Increasing hot-cache prewarm in the canary cohort to reduce misses.

tanya: Re-ran synthetic with hot cache — p95 back to 290ms. ops-sre, can you confirm production backfill?

ops-sre: Production tail improving, error_rate down to 0.25% across regions. Hold released, keeping ramp at 50% for an extra 30m before continuing.

deploy-bot: Ramp resume scheduled: wait 30m soak, then auto-continue to 100% unless manual hold.

leah: I'll update release notes post-mortem if we decide to mark the spike as transient.

kai: Final checklist before 100%:
- Confirm no queued infra scale events
- Confirm KV hit >=90% globally
- Confirm p50 <120ms and p95 <320ms
- Finance OK with cost delta

pranav: All checks green now from my side.

deploy-bot: 02:10 UTC: Final ramp to 100% initiated. Rollout ROLLOUT-20260320-017 complete.

sophia: Thanks everyone. Leaving rollout notes in the ticket and will schedule a short blameless write-up tomorrow. :party-parrot: If any customer impact surfaces, ping #support and tag me.

kai: Adding a follow-up action: add regional adaptive cache prewarming rule to avoid repeat of ap-south spike.

ops-sre: Action noted and assigned.

pranav: Closing my debug VM. Logs archived under the rollout link.

deploy-bot: Rollout ROLLOUT-20260320-017: status=success, pinned_versions=["router@v2.3.1","model-router@small-lm@q4"], duration=2h10m."
